battle.name: 卡吉爾戰爭
battle.brief: 卡吉爾戰爭是印度與巴基斯坦因克什米爾控制權爭端而引發的軍事衝突，於1999年5月爆發。印度陸軍在高山地形中投入蘇聯製BMP-2步兵戰鬥車，執行機動作戰、兵員輸送與步兵火力支援，並配合坦克作戰。

kit.name: BMP-2步兵戰鬥車
kit.history: 蘇聯陸軍機械化步兵的核心裝甲載具，負責伴隨坦克輸送兵員，並以機炮提供伴隨步兵火力支援。

countries: 1999年的卡吉爾戰爭，實際戰線位於印度與巴基斯坦之間的實際控制線（LoC）沿線，戰場集中在印控查謨和克什米爾的卡吉爾、德拉士、巴拉提克與昌昌山區，對面則是巴控喀什米爾的山地。越線後的第一道山脊，往往比後方公路和營地更能決定火力視線，也更能限制敵方的 artillery 射線。印度方面把越線隊伍稱為受巴基斯坦軍方支持的武裝滫透者，巴基斯坦則稱其為獨立的武裝分子，並否認本國軍隊直接指揮。交戰者因此包括印度軍隊、巴基斯坦軍隊，以及在前線與印度軍交手的武裝滫透隊伍，這不是一場由兩國正式宣戰後才開始的戰爭。印度把收復山脊的軍事行動命名為維杰行動（Operation Vijay）；這個名稱出現在五月以後，描述的是印度軍的攻勢，而不是戰爭的起點或所有交戰者的共同名稱。
countriesEn: The 1999 Kargil War was fought along the actual Line of Control (LoC) between India and Pakistan, mainly in the Kargil, Dras, Batalik, and Changthang mountain areas of Indian-administered Jammu and Kashmir, with the Pakistani-administered mountains on the opposite side. After crossing the line, the first ridge often mattered more than the roads and camps behind it for controlling fields of fire and restricting enemy artillery lines. India described the crossing groups as militant infiltrators supported by the Pakistani military, while Pakistan called them independent militants and denied direct direction by its armed forces. The belligerents therefore included the Indian Army, the Pakistani Army, and armed infiltrator groups that fought Indian forces on the forward line; this was not a war that began only after a formal declaration by the two states. India named the military effort to recapture the ridges Operation Vijay. The name was used for the Indian offensive from May onward and described that operation rather than the war’s beginning or a common name used by all belligerents.
people: 開戰前的政治指揮由印度總理阿塔利亞·比哈里·瓦杰帕伊和國防部長喬治·費爾南德斯負責，印度陸軍參謀長則是N. C. Vajpeyee。北方軍區指揮官V. K. Chaudhary中將把政治決定轉成山地作戰，第十五山地師由J. J. Singh少將指揮；第十一步兵旅由Rajeev Yaub准將率領，第八與第十八山地旅分別支援巴拉提克和德拉士方向的攻勢。巴基斯坦方面，總理納瓦茲·謝里夫主持政治層面，陸軍參謀長Pervez Musharraf、參謀長聯會主席穆罕默德·阿齊茲·汗中將，以及北方軍和第十軍的指揮官穆罕默德·馬蘇德·阿斯拉姆中將、Javed Ashraf Qazi少將共同構成軍事指揮鏈。武裝滫透隊伍的公開領導人則是哈菲茲·馬蘇德。這些人不是每一項決定都在同一處作出：首都決定談判與戰略目標，北部軍區安排兵力和火力，旅、營指揮官則負責把命令轉成具體的山脊攻勢。
peopleEn: Political direction at the beginning of the war came from Indian Prime Minister Atal Bihar Vajpayee and Defence Minister George Fernandes, while the Chief of the Army Staff was N. C. Vajpeyee. Northern Command was led by Lieutenant General V. K. Chaudhary, who translated political decisions into mountain operations. The 15th Mountain Division was commanded by Major General J. J. Singh; Brigadier Rajeev Yaub led the 11th Infantry Brigade, while the 8th and 18th Mountain Brigades supported operations in the Batalik and Dras sectors. On the Pakistani side, Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif handled the political level, while General Pervez Musharraf, Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Committee Lieutenant General Muhammad Aziz Khan, Northern Light Corps commander Lieutenant General Muhammad Masood Aslam, and 10 Corps commander Major General Javed Ashraf Qazi formed the military command structure. Hafiz Masood was the publicly named leader of the armed infiltrator organization. These commanders did not make every decision in one place: the capital set diplomatic and strategic aims, Northern Command arranged forces and fire support, and brigade and battalion commanders turned those orders into specific attacks on ridges.
kits: 到1999年，印度山地步兵可以使用5.56×45毫米INSAS步槍、7.62×51毫米SLR步槍和7.62毫米FN MAG通用機槍，並攜帶81毫米及120毫米迫擊炮。炮兵火力包括105毫米野戰炮、155毫米榴彈炮和25毫米高射炮，砲彈由後方射擊陣地送往前線。印度陸軍已有T-55與T-72坦克，T-90則在1999年才開始進入序列，不能把它的具體數量和每個陣地的部署寫成已核實的表格。印度空軍在卡吉爾行動中使用MiG-21與MiG-29，Su-30MKI在1999年剛開始列裝，公開資料對其在戰役中的實際出動架次並不完整。Mi-17/3、HAL Cheetah和Chetak則承担適合條件下的運輸、聯絡與傷員後送。飛機攻擊使用制式炸彈和火箭，包括250公斤及500公斤級炸彈。巴基斯坦前線常見配備包括G3步槍、MG3機槍、PKM通用機槍、RPG-7以及81毫米和120毫米迫擊炮；空軍序列中有F-16A/B、Mirage III與Mirage 5。山脊上真正決定火力的是輕武器、迫擊炮和機槍，坦克則主要在山谷與道路附近提供有限支援。
kitsEn: By 1999, Indian mountain infantry could use the 5.56 × 45 mm INSAS rifle, the 7.62 × 51 mm SLR rifle, and the 7.62 mm FN MAG general-purpose machine gun, together with 81 mm and 120 mm mortars. Artillery support included 105 mm field guns, 155 mm guns, and 25 mm anti-aircraft guns, with shells moved from firing positions behind the forward line. The Indian Army already had T-55 and T-72 tanks; the T-90 was only beginning to enter service in 1999, so its exact strength and location at individual ridges cannot be presented as verified figures. The Indian Air Force used MiG-21 and MiG-29 aircraft during the Kargil operation, while the Su-30MKI was just entering service in 1999 and public records do not give a complete count of its combat sorties. Mi-17/3, HAL Cheetah, and Chetak helicopters performed transport, liaison, and medical evacuation when conditions allowed. Air attacks used conventional bombs and rockets, including 250 kg and 500 kg class bombs. Pakistani forward equipment commonly included G3 rifles, MG3 machine guns, PKM general-purpose machine guns, RPG-7 launchers, and 81 mm and 120 mm mortars. The Pakistani air inventory included F-16A/B, Mirage III, and Mirage 5 aircraft. Machine guns, mortars, and light infantry weapons determined fire on the ridges, while tanks provided limited support mainly in valleys and near roads.
tactics: 滲透隊伍先以小組分散穿越山谷和缺口，利用春季尚未被季風封閉的路线，在卡吉爾、德拉士和巴拉提克的山脊上建立觀察哨、迫擊炮位和機槍陣位；這些陣位彼此能互相支援，並可觀察印度後方的道路與補給線。印度先依靠人力巡邏、空中偵察和衛星情報確認占領範圍，再於五月四日開始以炮兵和空軍火力壓制暴露位置。前線觀察員計算射擊諸元，MiG-21與MiG-29對固定陣地投彈或發射火箭，地面部隊則在火力準備後逐點接近。進攻不是單純正面衝撞：步兵先以側翼接近，切斷機槍射界和迫擊炮交通線，再由工兵處理障礙、掩體與後方陣位；裝甲車輛很難直接越過裸露山脊，通常留在谷地。空軍可以暫時壓制，卻不能代替步兵佔領和清查。巴基斯坦在七月初企圖以Operation Khanjar從北部山區向卡吉爾側翼推進，切斷印度補給，印度情報先期察覺後在若干關鍵鞍部部署反制兵力。補給由卡吉爾至德拉士的公路運到後方，再以騾匹和後勤人員分送到前線；直升機只在天氣和高度允許時運送急需的燃料、彈藥與傷員。稀薄空氣、濃霧、煙塵、碎石坡面和季風，使炮火與空地協同反覆中斷。
tacticsEn: Infiltrator groups first crossed valleys and gaps in small, dispersed teams, using routes that had not yet been closed by the monsoon to establish observation posts, mortar positions, and machine-gun emplacements on the ridges around Kargil, Dras, and Batalik. These positions supported one another and could observe Indian roads and supply lines behind them. India relied on patrols, aerial reconnaissance, and satellite intelligence to establish the occupied area, then began suppressing exposed positions with artillery and air power on May 4. Forward observers calculated firing parameters, while MiG-21 and MiG-29 aircraft attacked fixed positions with bombs and rockets. Infantry then approached point by point after the fire preparation. The assault was not simply a frontal rush: troops approached along the flanks, cut off machine-gun fields of fire and mortar movement routes, and used engineers against obstacles, bunkers, and rear positions. Armoured vehicles could rarely climb directly over exposed ridges and generally remained in the valleys. Air power could suppress temporarily but could not replace infantry in occupying and clearing positions. In early July, Pakistan attempted Operation Khanjar from the northern mountains toward the Kargil flank to cut Indian supply lines. Indian intelligence detected the plan in advance and deployed counterforces at several key saddles. Supplies moved by truck along the Kargil-Dras road to rear areas, then were carried forward by mules and logistics personnel. Helicopters moved urgent fuel, ammunition, and evacuated personnel only when weather and altitude permitted. Thin air, fog, smoke, loose rock, and the monsoon repeatedly interrupted artillery and air-ground coordination.
data: 時間線的第一個可核對節點出現在1999年五月初，印度巡邏隊在卡吉爾、德拉士和巴拉提克一帶發現越線者佔據山脊；五月四日印度啟動維杰行動，五月五日巴基斯坦開始以炮兵回應。五月二十七日曾發生MiG-21與F-16等機的空中接觸，但關於是否越過實際控制線、射擊距離和戰果的敘述不一致，因此只能確認接觸，不能把未經共同核實的擊落數字寫成定論。六月十三日，印度軍攻回托洛林方向包括Point 4875在內的高地；六月十八日又奪回Point 5140，海拔約五千一百四十公尺，是戰役中報導最頻繁的制高點之一。七月一日，巴基斯坦展開Operation Khanjar，試圖從北方側翼切斷卡吉爾的交通；七月十五日瓦杰帕伊在斯洛維尼亞會見美國總統克林頓，外部外交壓力明顯增加。七月26日印度宣布無條件停火，並要求巴基斯坦在七月29日前撤出印度一側據點；八月初印軍宣布卡吉爾戰區主要山脊與大部分陣地已恢復控制。前線海拔多在四千米至五千公尺以上，公路有限，公開資料常以約二十萬描述印度作戰及支援部隊，但作戰、後勤和指揮人員的統計口徑不同，巴基斯坦前沿總兵力則沒有同等可靠的公開表。印度政府事後公布陣亡軍人1,345人，巴基斯坦政府公布陣亡軍人453人；兩份數字屬各自官方口徑，受傷總數及武裝滲透者損失沒有共同核實，因此不把不同來源拼成一個看似精確的總傷亡數。
dataEn: The first verifiable point in the chronology came in early May 1999, when Indian patrols found infiltrators occupying ridges around Kargil, Dras, and Batalik. India launched Operation Vijay on May 4, and Pakistan began artillery retaliation on May 5. A short air engagement involving aircraft such as the MiG-21 and F-16 occurred on May 27, but accounts disagree over whether the aircraft crossed the Line of Control, the engagement range, and the results. The contact can therefore be recorded, but unverified shoot-down figures should not be presented as settled facts. On June 13, Indian forces recaptured the higher ground around Tololing, including Point 4875. On June 18, they retook Point 5140, an elevation of about 5,140 metres and one of the most frequently reported strongpoints of the war. Pakistan launched Operation Khanjar on July 1, attempting to approach the Kargil flank from the north and cut its communications. On July 15, Vajpayee met United States President Clinton in Slovenia, increasing visible diplomatic pressure. India announced an unconditional ceasefire on July 26 and required Pakistan to withdraw from positions on the Indian side by July 29. In early August, the Indian Army announced that it had regained the main ridges and most positions in the Kargil sector. Much of the forward area lay above 4,000 to 5,000 metres and had few roads. Public accounts often describe roughly 200,000 Indian combat and supporting personnel, but the totals combine different categories, while no equally reliable public table gives Pakistan’s forward strength. The Indian government later reported 1,345 military personnel killed, and the Pakistani government reported 453 military personnel killed. These are separate official counts; total wounded and infiltrator losses were not jointly verified, so they should not be combined into a supposedly exact grand total.
cause: 卡吉爾戰爭的長期背景是印巴對喀什米爾主權、實際控制線和邊境兵力部署長期無法定案。過去的戰爭與停火留下許多高山據點，實體控制線也不是能隨時封閉的普通陸界；對山地作戰而言，誰控制山脊、誰能維持彈藥和飲水，誰就可能控制局部戰場。1990年代查謨武裝衝突持續，巴基斯坦與武裝組織保持密切聯絡，印度情報單位認為巴基斯坦軍方策劃了越線滲透，但巴基斯坦一直否認國家直接參與。1980年代後期錫亞琴衝突與後續部署，使部分沿線據點的兵力重新分配，許多研究認為這為滲透留下可利用的缺口。1998年印度進行核試驗後，南亞的戰略風險升高；巴基斯坦軍方部分人士擔心印度會利用新的軍事優勢發動攻勢，因而選擇在季風來臨前奪取山脊，以取得談判籌碼並迫使印度接受既成局勢。印度則把這種越線視為對實際控制線和軍隊部署的改變，不能容忍。發現陣地後，印度要求完整撤軍，巴基斯坦提出有條件的撤軍方案，雙方對撤離範圍、查驗方式與停火條件未能達成一致，最終由炮兵、空軍和步兵開始大規模收復行動。
causeEn: The long-term background to the Kargil War was the unresolved dispute over Kashmir, the Line of Control, and the deployment of forces along the border. Earlier wars and ceasefires left numerous high-altitude positions, while the Line of Control was not an ordinary land boundary that could be sealed at will. In mountain warfare, control of a ridge and the ability to sustain ammunition, food, and fuel could determine the local battle. Armed conflict in Kashmir continued through the 1990s, and Pakistan maintained close links with militant organizations. Indian intelligence believed that the Pakistani military had planned the infiltration, although Pakistan consistently denied direct state involvement. The earlier Siachen conflict and subsequent redeployments moved troops away from some forward areas, and many studies identified the resulting gaps as an opportunity for infiltration. After India conducted nuclear tests in 1998, strategic risk in South Asia rose. Some Pakistani military leaders feared that India would exploit its new military balance and therefore sought to seize ridges before the monsoon, create bargaining leverage, and force India to accept a new fait accompli. India regarded the crossing as an unacceptable change to the Line of Control and existing troop deployments. Once the positions were discovered, India demanded complete withdrawal, while Pakistan offered conditional proposals. The two sides could not agree on the area of withdrawal, verification, or ceasefire terms, so artillery, air power, and infantry began the large-scale recapture effort.
impact: 戰後的軍事檢討首先指出，山脊本身不是永久防禦工事；滲透者若沒有可靠補給、替換彈藥和保持觀察的能力，短時間內可以製造突然的火力優勢，但一旦道路、騾匹路線或直升機運輸被切斷，陣位就會迅速失去戰役價值。印度因此重新檢視高山作戰中的情報確認、炮兵觀察、空地協同、直升機後勤和逐點攻擊，並把德拉士、卡吉爾一帶的經驗納入後續訓練與裝備規劃。巴基斯坦則暴露了以小規模滲透建立高點的風險：這種方式能取得戰術主動，卻難以承受印度空軍與炮兵的系統性反擊，也無法確保山脊在季風前形成可持續的防線。戰役同時把南亞核風險推到國際外交核心。美國在七月推動外交接觸，克林森與瓦杰帕伊的會晤成為停火的重要外部壓力，但雙方沒有因此解決喀什米爾問題。巴基斯坦軍方的戰役失利削弱納瓦茲·謝里夫政府的政治地位，成為同年十月軍事政變的重要背景因素之一；印度的軍事結果則暫時支持了瓦杰帕伊政府，卻也促使軍方繼續推動高海拔作戰、後勤和空軍能力的現代化。這場戰爭加深了印巴對實際控制線、跨境滲透和邊境情報的警覺，但沒有改變雙方對喀什米爾主權的基本立場。
impactEn: Postwar military reviews concluded that a ridge is not a permanent fortification. Infiltrators could create a sudden fire advantage if they had reliable resupply, ammunition, and observation, but once roads, mule routes, or helicopter transport were cut, the positions lost much of their value quickly. India therefore reassessed intelligence confirmation, artillery observation, air-ground coordination, helicopter logistics, and point-by-point attacks in mountain terrain, incorporating lessons from Dras and Kargil into later training and equipment planning. Pakistan’s infiltration method also showed the risks of using small teams to seize heights: it could create tactical surprise, but it was difficult to withstand systematic Indian air and artillery counterattacks or to turn the ridges into a sustainable defense before the monsoon. The war brought the South Asian nuclear risk to the centre of international diplomacy. American pressure in July, including the meeting between Clinton and Vajpayee, became an important external influence on the ceasefire, but it did not resolve the Kashmir dispute. Pakistan’s military setback weakened the political position of Nawaz Sharif’s government and became one important background factor in the military coup of October 1999. India’s military outcome temporarily supported the Vajpayee government, but it also encouraged the army to continue modernizing its high-altitude warfare, logistics, and air capabilities. The conflict deepened mutual Indian and Pakistani concern over the Line of Control, cross-border infiltration, and border intelligence, while leaving their fundamental positions on Kashmir unchanged.
result: 七月26日，印度宣布無條件停火，並給予巴基斯坦到七月二十九日的撤軍期限；八月一日前後，印軍宣布卡吉爾戰區的主要山脊和大部分前進陣地已重新控制。德拉士、托洛林和卡吉爾外圍的關鍵高程點，包括Point 4875和Point 5140，重新由印度軍隊掌握。巴基斯坦軍隊及其支持的武裝人員撤出大部分印度一側據點，部分被俘者則依後續安排交換返回。Operation Khanjar沒有改變停火時的整體控制線，季風和高山補給限制也使任何一方都難以再把局部攻勢擴成全面山地戰役。印度實現了清除越線滲透、收復主要山脊的直接軍事目標，但停火不是正式和平條約，也沒有解決實際控制線的來源、主權或邊境兵力問題。雙方仍各自在線內保持部隊，喀什米爾的爭議因而從一場明確的邊境攻擊，轉為長期的軍力對峙與下一次危機的來源。
resultEn: On July 26, India announced an unconditional ceasefire and gave Pakistan until July 29 to withdraw. Around August 1, the Indian Army announced that the main ridges and most forward positions in the Kargil sector had been brought back under Indian control. Key high points around Dras, Tololing, and the approaches to Kargil, including Point 4875 and Point 5140, were once again held by Indian forces. Pakistani troops and the armed infiltrators withdrew from most positions on the Indian side, while some prisoners were returned under later arrangements. Operation Khanjar did not change the overall line at the time of the ceasefire, and the monsoon and high-altitude supply constraints made it difficult for either side to turn a local offensive into a full mountain war. India achieved its immediate military objective of removing the infiltration and recapturing the principal ridges, but the ceasefire was not a formal peace treaty and did not settle the source, sovereignty, or troop arrangements of the Line of Control. Both sides retained forces on their respective sides, so the Kashmir dispute remained a long-term military standoff and a source of future crises.
